verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents threshold-based alerts that notify over Slack, GitHub Actions, or webhooks when a metric crosses a threshold. It also explicitly documents alerting when spend crosses a threshold, which covers the cost-spike and Slack path of the story. Both mentions are brief one-liners, so the depth of the capability is not shown. missing for 10: explicit evidence of alerts on error rates and eval-score drops, native PagerDuty or email channels, in-depth alert configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
